# Sociodigit

> Sociodigit is a premier AI-powered IT consulting, software engineering, and digital growth agency headquartered in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India, serving 200+ global clients.

## About Sociodigit
- **Company Name**: Sociodigit
- **Website**: https://sociodigit.in
- **Email**: hi@sociodigit.in
- **Phone**: +91-7008381630
- **Headquarters**: HP4, Phase 2, Brit Colony, Laxmisagar, Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751006, India
- **Core Specialization**: AI-Driven Software Engineering, Cloud Architecture & DevOps, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & SEO, UX/UI Product Design, QA Automation, and Hotel Fraud Control.

---

## Core Services

- [Software Development](https://sociodigit.in/services/software-development): Full-stack web and mobile application engineering using React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, and cloud-native microservices.
- [DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure](https://sociodigit.in/services/devops): Cloud architecture, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes orchestration, Docker, AWS, GCP, and Azure management.
- [SEO Agency in Bhubaneswar](https://sociodigit.in/seo-agency-bhubaneswar): #1 AI-powered SEO agency in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. Technical SEO, Google Map 3-Pack ranking, E-E-A-T authority, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
- [Digital Marketing & Growth](https://sociodigit.in/services/digital-marketing): Data-driven performance marketing, PPC ad campaigns, social media marketing, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
- [Security Consulting](https://sociodigit.in/services/security-consulting): Vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, compliance auditing (SOC2, ISO 27001), and zero-trust cloud security.
- [Content Strategy](https://sociodigit.in/services/content-strategy): High-authority technical content, SEO copywriting, brand narrative, and GEO-optimized AI knowledge base building.
- [Digital Transformation](https://sociodigit.in/services/digital-transformation): Modernizing legacy enterprise systems with cloud-first, AI-augmented architectures.
- [UI/UX Product Design](https://sociodigit.in/services/product-design): User research, wireframing, high-fidelity Figma design systems, interaction design, and usability testing.
- [Custom Apps Development](https://sociodigit.in/services/custom-apps): Bespoke enterprise web and mobile applications tailored for specialized business workflows.
- [QA & Test Automation](https://sociodigit.in/services/qa-automation): Automated testing suites, performance stress-testing, unit/integration testing, and CI/CD quality gates.
- [IT Consulting & Strategy](https://sociodigit.in/services/consulting): CTO-as-a-Service, digital roadmaps, tech audits, and enterprise architecture advisory.
- [Hotel Fraud Control](https://sociodigit.in/hotel-fraud-control): Specialized anti-fraud and revenue protection solutions for hospitality and hotel businesses.

## Industries Served

- [Startups](https://sociodigit.in/industries/startups): MVP development, rapid scaling, and modern product architecture.

- [Healthcare](https://sociodigit.in/industries/healthcare): HIPAA-compliant patient management, telehealth platforms, and health tech workflows.
- [Hospitality & Hotels](https://sociodigit.in/industries/hospitality-hotels): Revenue management, booking engines, and fraud prevention systems.
- [SaaS](https://sociodigit.in/industries/saas): Multi-tenant architecture, subscription billing, and product-led growth engineering.
- [Enterprises](https://sociodigit.in/industries/enterprises): Digital transformation, enterprise data pipelines, and infrastructure modernization.
